gloss: to voice an objection; to raise a protest

definitions.gloss: to voice an objection; to raise a protest; to object
definitions.explanation: To formally or publicly express disagreement or opposition to a decision, plan, or statement. Used in legal, political, and everyday contexts when someone speaks up against something.

examples.japanese: {異議|いぎ}を{唱|とな}える⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいません⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異議|いぎ}を{唱|とな}えた。
examples.english: The residents voiced objections to the plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{異議|いぎ}を{唱|とな}えた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{多数決|たすうけつ}→多数決：16369_tasuuketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was the only one to raise an objection at the meeting, but it was voted down by majority.

notes: A set phrase combining ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧ (objection/dissent) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to advocate/voice). Common in meetings, legal proceedings, and public discourse. In parliamentary or meeting settings, the chair may ask ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Are there any objections?) or ⟦{異議|いぎ}なし→異議なし：24195_iginashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認|みと}めます→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (No objections noted; motion carried). Related expressions: ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{立|た}てる→申し立てる：27400_moushitateru⟧ (to file an objection, more formal/legal), ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧ (to oppose, more general).
